title.narrative: DRIVE (Diversion and Reintegration Interventions Vital for Empowerment)

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action, DRIVE (Diversion and Reintegration Interventions Vital for Empowerment) is to strengthen policy, practices and procedures to improve services for 3000 children at risk of or are in conflict with the law through collaboration with key stakeholders (Ministry of Home Affairs (MoHA) Juvenile Justice Department (JJD) and Guyana Police Force (GPF), the CPA within the Ministry of Human Services (MoHS) and Childrens Court for improved governance of the juvenile justice system in line with the Juvenile Justice Act 2018 (JJ Act 2018), by June 2025.
